mentions.name: JSON Query
mentions.description: Mac App Store app for storing, organizing, and querying JSON with jq or natural language, keeping all data local so sensitive JSON stays on the machine.
mentions.source_excerpt: The original JSON Query app on the Mac App Store. Store, organize and query all of your JSON with jq or natural language. All of your data stays local so sensitive JSON can stay on your machine.
mentions.author: aggregator-ios
